name: discuss
description: ADR-driven development, agent spec conventions, decision grilling, and English-only written artifacts

interface.shortDescription: Design-time reasoning: RFCs, ADRs, project rules, and decision grilling
interface.longDescription: Skills for the design phase. Grill a plan until the branching decisions are settled, log the discussion as an append-only RFC, record the outcome as an atomically-edited ADR, publish project rules where any harness will find them, and keep every written artifact in English regardless of the conversation language.
defaultPrompt: Grill this plan before I implement it.
Record this decision as an ADR.
Put this project rule where every agent finds it.
